card.name: The word crisis in general writing
card.fires_on: The noun "crisis" or "crises" in general web text, usually after "the" or "a", about a historical, political or social upheaval.

modes.label: Named historical crisis
modes.description: "crisis" after "the", naming a particular historical or social upheaval.
modes.example: Teaching about the<< crises>> in Japan is the focus of this episode

modes.label: Crisis of an era or idea
modes.description: "crisis" followed by "of" plus a period, belief or date.
modes.example: Even more validation comes from some basic checks of key Victorian themes such as the<< crisis>> of faith.

card.plain: It lights up on the word "crisis" when a text talks about a big political, social or historical upheaval.
